task_title: P2 — the fleet ops census classifies code-factory as `docs` and judges it on nothing, so this family operational surface is outside every ops check
task_criteria: Filing, not fix. On a clean tip the board diff is insert-only: `git show --stat --oneline HEAD` names only .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl with 1 insertion and 0 deletions each. The row is present in the COMMITTED tree: `jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-206") | .probe' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl` prints one non-empty physical line, and `git show HEAD:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl | jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-206") | .probe'` prints the same line. Running that exact printed line from the repository root prints `docs` and exits 0 (today). `bash scripts/boardctl validate` reports RESULT: OK and `bash tests/selftest.sh` reports SELFTEST: PASS at the same tip. The census misclassification itself is PENDING by definition - do not evaluate or grade the fix, only the filing.
